settings_calendar_links_description: A Calendar Link is a secret URL that publishes the Planned and Due Dates of your open Tasks as a read-only calendar. Anyone with the URL can see those Tasks, so delete the link to revoke access.
settings_calendar_links_help: Add a Calendar Link to your calendar app
settings_calendar_links_help_refresh: Calendar apps refresh subscribed calendars on their own schedule, often only every few hours, so changes may not show up right away.
settings_calendar_links_help_step_copy: Copy the URL of a Calendar Link below.
settings_calendar_links_help_step_paste: Paste the URL, give the calendar a name and save.
settings_calendar_links_help_step_subscr: In your calendar app, look for an option to subscribe to a calendar or add one from a URL.
